Not a fork."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Its flagship feature, **`/ship`**, turns a one-sentence idea into fully verified code through an aut"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"onomous 7-stage engineering pipeline, with a built-in live task flow panorama across terminal and br"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"s 7-stage engineering pipeline, with a built-in live task flow panorama across terminal and browser."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Want to see what it builds? Visit the gallery for real projects, screenshots, and playable results. "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"Every project was built from a **one-sentence request**, with just **one round of interaction** and "},{"id":"p6s3","text":"the **recommended answer selected for every question**."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Common flags:
- `codsh -p "task"` — Run a non-interactive task directly
- `codsh --continue` — Conti"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"nue the last session
- `codsh --resume <id>` — Resume a specific session
- `codsh update` — Update l"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"auncher and profile runtime"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## `/ship`: One Sentence to Verified Code"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"`/ship` automates the complete engineering workflow from idea to delivery:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"1. **Pre-flight** — Checks git working tree state and creates an isolated `ship/<slug>` branch.
2. *"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"*Wayfinder** — Clarifies core goals, constraints, and trade-offs.
3. **Grill** — Interactive design "},{"id":"p13s3","text":"interview with smart, recommended defaults.
4. **Spec (Gate 1)** — Formulates user stories, public s"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"eams, and explicit Out of Scope boundaries.
5. **Tickets (Gate 2)** — Decomposes work into vertical "},{"id":"p13s5","text":"slices structured as an explicit dependency DAG.
6. **Landing** — Dispatches tickets into parallel G"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"it worktrees for TDD implementation and continuous integration.
7. **Done** — Verifies acceptance cr"},{"id":"p13s7","text":"iteria, ensures zero repo regressions, and merges back cleanly."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### Live Task Flow Panorama
- **Live TTY Teaser**: Pinned status row showing real-time ticket counts"},{"id":"p14s2","text":" (`待认领 n · 已认领 n · 已关闭 n`), in-flight parallel landing worktrees, and the Web flowchart URL.
- **ASC"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"II DAG Overlay (`Ctrl+G`)**: Instant fullscreen terminal visualization of task dependencies and clai"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"m states.
- **Local Web Flowchart**: Interactive React Flow map (`127.0.0.1:<port>`) with decision c"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"ontext, recorded Q&As;, and landing tickets."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### Autonomous Resilience
- **Automated Conflict Resolution**: Git merge conflicts (including lockfi"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"les and renames) are autonomously resolved by agent sub-tasks with validation retries.
- **Pause & R"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"esume**: `Ctrl+C` safely pauses coordination; running a bare `/ship` resumes unfinished work from wh"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"` safely pauses coordination; running a bare `/ship` resumes unfinished work from where it left off."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## The surface"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Designed for high-efficiency, keyboard-driven terminal development:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- **Clean Terminal UI**: Full-screen alternate buffer; input stays pinned at the bottom; restores yo"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"ur shell cleanly on exit.
- **DeepSeek Blue Themes**: `/theme` opens a picker that previews each the"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"me live (arrows preview, `Enter` saves, `Esc` reverts); `/theme <name>` switches directly. `auto` (d"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"efault) follows the terminal's light or dark background with `deepseek` / `deepseek-light`; `termina"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"l` paints only your terminal's own sixteen colours, with no backgrounds. The choice is saved in `$DS"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"H_HOME/code-cli-ui.json`; `CODSH_THEME=<name>` overrides it for one launch.
- **Foldable Reasoning**"},{"id":"p18s7","text":": Streaming thoughts collapse into a single line (`Ctrl+O` or click to expand/collapse).
- **Subagen"},{"id":"p18s8","text":"t Matrix**: Background and parallel subagents run in isolated views (`Ctrl+H` to list, click/enter t"},{"id":"p18s9","text":"o inspect, `Esc` to return).
- **Todos That Keep Up**: The agent's todo list stays pinned above the "},{"id":"p18s10","text":"status row (`Ctrl+T` or a click opens it whole). When the agent makes 20 tool calls with an open lis"},{"id":"p18s11","text":"t unchanged, or a compaction drops the list from its context, codsh shows the model its list again s"},{"id":"p18s12","text":"o the pinned item follows the real work. `CODSH_TODO_REMINDER=<calls>` changes the count for one lau"},{"id":"p18s13","text":"nch; `off` turns the reminder off.
- **Timeline Navigation**: Jump between dialogue turns (`Shift+←/"},{"id":"p18s14","text":"→`, `/jump`) or branch off from an earlier turn (`/rewind`).
- **Shortcuts & Controls**:
- `Shift+Ta"},{"id":"p18s15","text":"b`: Toggle plan mode
- `Ctrl+Q`: Queue input while the agent is running
- Settings and view commands"},{"id":"p18s16","text":" (`/theme`, `/model`, `/effort`, `/thinking`, `/ui`, `/permission`, `/plan`, `/status`, `/view`, `/d"},{"id":"p18s17","text":"iff`, `/copy`, `/jump`, …) take effect at once, even mid-turn — they are never queued; a model or th"},{"id":"p18s18","text":"inking switch applies from the running turn's next step
- `Ctrl+C`: Interrupt current execution
- `C"},{"id":"p18s19","text":"trl+V`: Paste images directly from clipboard
- `/view`, `/diff`, `/copy`: Inspect files, uncommitted"},{"id":"p18s20","text":" changes, or code blocks in a dedicated pager"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Third-party endpoints"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Connect to any OpenAI-compatible gateway by adding an `llm-pi-ai` entry to the `code` profile's own "},{"id":"p20s2","text":"patch layer, `$DSH_HOME/profiles/code/cordis.patch.yml` (default `~/.dsh/profiles/code/cordis.patch."},{"id":"p20s3","text":"yml`), which applies after every bundle:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"A `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml` from an earlier dsh is imported once on the next start and renamed `sett"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"ings.yaml.imported`; edit the profile patch from then on."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Switch and persist default model:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"API keys resolve in order: specified environment variable → `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` → `<cwd>/."},{"id":"p25s2","text":"env` → `$DSH_HOME/.env`."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"`codsh` is a zero-dependency launcher that finds your local `dsh`, registers `codsh-bundle` into a `"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"code` profile, and boots `dsh --profile code`."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"codsh needs dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 or newer; the launcher refuses an older `dsh` and prints the command that"},{"id":"p28s2","text":" installs a new enough one. The `code-cli` agent preset ships inside the bundle as a dsh preset decl"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"aration (`presets/code-cli.patch.yml`). dsh 0.1.7 stopped reading presets from directories, so a cop"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"y an earlier codsh left in `$DSH_HOME/.agent-presets/code-cli` is no longer used."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"To run directly via dsh:"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"}],"truncated":true}
